# King James Version (KJV) Bible

## Release Information
- Version: 1.0
- Release Date: 2023-07-15
- Format: USX (Unified Scripture XML)

## Contents
This package contains the King James Version of the Bible in USX format. The following files are included:

- *.usx: Unified Scripture XML files — one per biblical book (e.g., GEN.usx, JHN.usx)
- metadata.xml: Metadata about the translation (language, project name, abbreviation, etc.)
- styles.xml: Defines how each USX/USFM marker should be rendered or formatted
- versification.vrs: Maps standard biblical references to the KJV verse structure
- license.xml: Specifies that the text is in the public domain
- README.txt: This file

## Usage Guidelines
1. This text is in the public domain and may be freely used for any purpose.
2. No attribution is required, but it is appreciated.
3. The text should be referred to as the "King James Version" or "KJV".

## Technical Notes
- The USX files follow the USX 3.0 specification.
- Character encoding is UTF-8.
- The versification follows the standard KJV versification system.

## Contact
For questions or support, please contact example@example.com.
